title: primula gemmifera subsp. rupestris
intro: Primula gemmifera subsp. rupestris, commonly known as the alpine cowslip or rocky primrose, is a plant species in the genus Primula, characterized by its delicate yellow or white flowers and rugged growth habit. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Primula gemmifera subsp. rupestris include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, iridoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
